cards.name: Happy Ending
cards.text:
300% Shield.
Fixed heal equal to Shield in possession (does not exceed 30% of max HP).

cards.name: Gather Around
cards.text: 100% Defense-Based Damage.

cards.name: Fairy's Protection
cards.text: 100% Shield.

cards.name: Once Upon A Time
cards.text: Apply Blessing to 2 random cards in Draw Pile, Draw 1 of those cards.

cards.name: Once Upon A Time I
cards.text: Apply Blessing to 3 random cards in Draw Pile, Draw 1 of those cards.

cards.name: Once Upon A Time II
cards.text: Select and draw 1 from Draw Pile, then apply Blessing to those cards.

cards.name: Once Upon A Time III
cards.text: Discard 1 random card(s) from Draw Pile; Apply Blessing to 3 random card(s) of the Combatant who owns the Discarded card.

cards.name: Once Upon A Time IV
cards.text: Draw equal to X, then apply Blessing to those cards.

cards.name: Once Upon A Time V
cards.text: When a card is created, apply Blessing (5 times per turn).

cards.name: Protect Us
cards.text: Draw 1 Blessing card on the next 2 Blessing card uses.

cards.name: Protect Us I
cards.text: For the next 3 Blessing cards activated, draw 1 Blessing card.

cards.name: Protect Us II
cards.text: The next 2 times 0 cards are in hand, draw 1 Blessing card.

cards.name: Protect Us III
cards.text:
Draw 3.
change Cost of those cards to 0-2 for 1 turn.

cards.name: Protect Us IV
cards.text:
Draw 1.
if that card is a Blessing card, add 1 Draw.

cards.name: Protect Us V
cards.text:
Draw 2 Blessing card(s) of this unit.
Increase Damage and Shield Gain Amount of those cards by 60% for 1 turn.

cards.name: Friends from Fairy Tales
cards.text: Select and create 1 Doggie or Teddy card.

cards.name: Friends from Fairy Tales I
cards.text:
Create 1 Doggie.
+20% Damage Amount to Doggie for every 1 Blessing card in possession (max 15 cards).

cards.name: Friends from Fairy Tales II
cards.text:
Create 1 Teddy.
If Damage is taken, move Teddy to hand (1 time per turn).

cards.name: Friends from Fairy Tales III
cards.text: Create 4 Doggie (Pack) in Draw Pile.

cards.name: Friends from Fairy Tales IV
cards.text:
Create 1 Teddy.
When Teddy is used, 1 Counterattack, and for 1 turn, Retain Counterattack.

cards.name: Friends from Fairy Tales V
cards.text: Create 1 Doggie (Morphed).

cards.name: Truth Behind A Story
cards.text:
200% Defense-Based Damage.
+100% Damage Amount taken by the target for 1 turn.

cards.name: Truth Behind A Story I
cards.text:
300% Defense-Based Damage.
2 Weaken, +100% Damage Amount taken by the target for 1 turn.

cards.name: Truth Behind A Story II
cards.text:
200% Defense-Based Damage
Move 2 Blessing card(s) from Discard Pile to hand.

cards.name: Truth Behind A Story III
cards.text:
200% Defense-Based Damage.
Increase Damage and Shield Gain Amounts of Doggie and Teddy by 100% for 1 turn.

cards.name: Truth Behind A Story IV
cards.text:
400% Defense-Based Damage.
Increase Damage Amount by 30% for each Blessing card in hand.

cards.name: Truth Behind A Story V
cards.text:
300% Defense-Based Damage.
Increase Action Count by 4.

cards.name: Garden of Secrets
cards.text: 200% Shield, 25% Shield Retention.

cards.name: Doggie
cards.text: 60% Defense-Based Damage × 4.

cards.name: Teddy
cards.text: 200% Shield, 2 Damage Reduction.

cards.name: Doggie (Pack)
cards.text:
200% Defense-Based Damage.
Increase Damage Amount by 50% for each Doggie Linked before activation.

cards.name: Doggie (Morphed)
cards.text:
90% Defense-Based Damage × 4.
When an Attack Card is activated, change this card to Teddy (Morphed).

cards.name: Teddy (Morphed)
cards.text:
300% Shield.
3 Damage Reduction.
When a Skill Card is activated, change this card to Doggie (Morphed).

potentials.name: Epiphany Bonus
potentials.text: When entering Chaos, obtain 1 random Rare Card with an activated Epiphany.

potentials.name: Basic Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Basic Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Common Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Common Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: Add Blessing to Gather Around and Fairy's Protection cards.

potentials.name: Unique Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Unique Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: +5% Shield Gain Amount to Adelheid's Fairy's Protection. If Adelheid's Defense is greater than 250, add an additional +5% to the modifier

potentials.name: Divine Epiphany Adaptation
potentials.text: Increases the chance for a Divine Epiphany to appear by 25%.

potentials.name: Unique Stat Upgrade
potentials.text: If Adelheid's Defense is greater than 300, +5% Void-Attribute Damage Amount. For every 10 Defense exceeding 300, add an additional 2% to the modifier (additional +10% max).

manifestEgo.name: Sleeping Memory
manifestEgo.text: For the Garden of Secrets card, decrease Cost by 1 and add +100% Shield Gain Amount.

manifestEgo.name: Awakening Memory
manifestEgo.text:
Gain the Bliss of Dreams effect for each Blessing Adelheid applies or creates. At the start of the turn, gain the Bliss of Dreams effect for each Blessing card in possession
Bliss of Dreams: Increase Damage Amount of allies by 3% (max 10 stacks)

manifestEgo.name: Vivid Memory
manifestEgo.text: +200% Shield Gain Amount to Happy Ending. Changes the restrictions of the Fixed Heal equal to Shield in possession effect to (does not exceed 50% of max HP).

manifestEgo.name: Inner Memory
manifestEgo.text:
At the start of battle, apply Blessing to any number of cards in hand.
When a Blessing Upgrade Card is used, apply Blessing to 1 random card in Draw Pile.

manifestEgo.name: Complete Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase the level of [Basic Card Upgrade], [Unique Card Upgrade], and [Common Card Upgrade] in Potentials by 3.

manifestEgo.name: Liberated Memory
manifestEgo.text: For Bliss of Dreams, decrease max stacks by 5 and change the increased Damage Amount effect to 8%. At the start of the turn, if Bliss of Dreams is 5, Draw 1 Blessing card.
